title: Decoding state length bound
statement: For every binary word $w$ and natural number $j$, the length of the state for $w$ at count $j$ is at most $2|w|+3j+4$, where $|w|$ denotes the length of $w$.
replaced: For every binary target $w$ and count $j$, the decoding state has length at most $2|w| + 3j + 4$; candidate and answer storage grow only with the supplied unary clock, even for a malformed target denoting a huge value.
